horizon: Exactly the fifth subsequent completed original market-session stock close, excluding signal day, whose original raw-signal row is observed, price/volume eligible, nonsynthetic, source-valid, finite positive close/amount/volume and same comparable segment. This is a valid traded-quote proxy, not actual buy/sell fillability or capacity certification.
halt_missing: Observed same-domain zero amount/volume is explicit NO_TRADE_QUOTE: skip it, count delay and valid-observation age. Absent/invalid/unknown quote or domain change before the fifth valid close makes the precise horizon ambiguous; do not silently skip unknown gaps and call the sixth/tenth close the fifth. Signal-day bad quote has its own status. No funding/actual execution is never a price-label missing reason. Pending at t stays pending even if later source quotes exist.
label: C_fifth/C_signal-1 using original same-source causal signal close. Publish only at the fifth close; source_max_used never later than that maturity. No fee, execution, floor exit, MFE or future terminal winner field enters feedback.
price_tail: For each evaluation segment, existing quote observations may extend exactly5 original market sessions beyond its last date for offline forward-response evaluation. Signal authorization windows do not extend. Longer delayed responses remain right-censored within this bounded view. Main daily as-of never releases those future labels early.
queue: Original signal-day cohorts retained with membership, maturity fraction, delay/missing. Publish events individually on their actual maturity day; never wait for every original cohort member and never backfill a late member into earlier outputs. Aggregation uses maturity-day batches.
lookback: At each original market CLOSE take maturity batches within current and previous4 market sessions, fixed calendar including empty days. Nonempty batch j has total weight1/B, each event weight1/(B*n_j). Empty days contribute no zero return; B=0 is NO_MATURE_DATA. Publish B,N,batch sizes,new batch count,latest information age and delayed-member concentration. No alternative K or nonempty-batch fallback chosen after outcomes.
statistics: Weighted median, weighted positive share, weighted p10 loss-tail and weighted negative-return mean. Weighted inverse empirical CDF after sorting and combining equal values: first value whose cumulative weight>=q; no averaging at an exact.5 tie. Fractions/weights exact, return comparisons use original float64. Also retain each batch's raw event median/positive/p10 and event count.
forward_falsification: As-of t feedback median natural sign positive/negative/zero/NO_DATA is compared descriptively with first-signal cohorts authorized on the next original market session, whose own5-close results are evaluation-only and cannot enter t. Retain every target before checking label availability. Future day outside the fixed signal evaluation window is boundary-truncated. Compare all three windows and original market context, do not pick a profitable cell or invert a failed predictor.
uncertainty: Fixed moving-block bootstrap of5 market-session as-of rows,1000 resamples, seed20261104, reports95% intervals for positive-minus-negative feedback groups' next-cohort daily median mean. Overlap, delayed observations and current-snapshot selection remain; no account advantage inferred from statistical separation.
